Hello @James. Check

Thank you for providing the details.

We will be splitting the reported concerns into two separate RCS tickets so they can be investigated and tracked individually:

For the issue: RCS-28351 - Unable to Attach Files to Case Reports -
Since the conversion, you have not been able to attach files to case reports.

For this issue, could you please confirm the file type and file size of the attachment that is failing to upload?

RCS-28373 – Audit Photos Not Visible in Printed Reports
Photos can be attached to audits successfully. However, they are not visible when the audit report is printed.

We will track and investigate these as two separate issues.

Kind Regards,

Appriss Retail Support
